summary: Infrabyte Consulting invites applications for Graduate Engineer Interns across engineering disciplines. The internship provides real-world exposure, structured learning, and hands-on project experience.
responsibilities: Assist teams in development, analysis, testing, or operational tasks
Work on assigned projects related to your engineering domain
Participate in requirement analysis, documentation, and reporting
Support process improvement and automation initiatives
Learn and apply industry tools, standards, and best practices
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve project goals
Follow quality guidelines and project timelines
required_skills: Basic understanding of core engineering concepts
Willingness to learn new technologies or tools
Professional attitude and strong work ethics
qualifications: Recently completed B.E / B.Tech in any engineering branch
benefits: Hands-on experience with real industry projects
Mentorship from experienced engineers and professionals
Opportunity to convert into a Full-Time Engineer / Associate Role based on performance
